title: UK to Refuel Saudi Jets in Anti-Houthi Operations
detail: The United Kingdom announced it will refuel Saudi Arabian jets engaged in operations to counter Houthi attacks, marking a significant escalation in British military support for Saudi Arabia's anti-Houthi campaign. The move signals deepening Western backing for the Saudi-led coalition as Houthi strikes on Red Sea shipping and Saudi territory have intensified.

media.caption: UK announces military support to Saudi Arabia to counter Houthi attacks
